title: The Real Effects of Implicit Government Guarantee: Evidence from Chinese State-Owned Enterprise Defaults
eligible_reason: Not eligible. The only staggered design (Table 5: local_post = 1 after the firm's province has its first local-SOE bond default; province-year cohorts 2015-2018; firm FE and industry x year FE; clustered by firm) includes six time-varying firm controls (lag_lat lag_tang lag_lev lag_roa cf sg) in both reported columns, and no controls-free column exists in the paper or the package. Verified in the do-file (Program.do lines 259-260) by the replication agent on 2026-11-01; confirmed independently by a second screener from the article text. All other tables are single-date SOE x Post designs around the April 2015 Tianwei default on PSM-matched samples, with controls.
design_notes: staggered.dta: 4,440 bond-issuing nonfinancial firms (firmid), year 2011-2019 (2011 dropped in code), 33,930 rows; local_post = 1 in 2,003 firm-years; first-treatment years: 2015 (82 firms), 2016 (356), 2017 (3), 2018 (130); 5 firms treated at first observed year; no switch-off. Regression: reghdfe totinv local_post lag_lat lag_tang lag_lev lag_roa cf sg, absorb(firmid ind_year) cluster(firmid) keepsing, after winsor2 at 1/99 and dropping missing controls; column 2 restricts to local SOEs (if local==1). Main-text results (log file): Local x Post -0.011** (0.005) in both columns; N = 27,792 and 18,087; adj. R2 0.530 / 0.517. Other tables: Table 3-4, 6-7 are SOE x Post (single date, PSM-matched, with controls); Table 1 bond event study; Table 8-10 listed-firm subsamples and M&A CARs.
estimators_reported: single-date DiD with PSM matching and controls (Tables 3, 4, 6, 7)

screener_notes: Package (archive ~/did_packages/mnsc/mnsc.2022.4483/_archive_mnsc.2022.4483.zip; inner zip truncated) contains Program.do, log.log, README PDF, and Data/ with staggered.dta, unmatched.dta, matched.dta, placebo.dta, merger_return.dta, listed_firms.dta, event_study.dta, bond_term.dta (WIND/CSMAR-derived, licensed sources, analysis files shipped). The only staggered design (Table 5) is a robustness/extension table and both columns carry time-varying controls; dropping them would be a protocol deviation. If the lead accepts deviations, a no-controls TWFE/CSA on staggered.dta (totinv ~ local_post | firmid + ind_year) is trivial to run, with never-treated provinces as controls and 4 cohorts. REPLICATION AGENT (2026-11-01): do-file verified; both Table 5 columns carry the six controls. Authors' TWFE reproduced exactly from staggered.dta (col 1: -0.0110927 (0.0048529), N 27,792; col 2: -0.0106724 (0.0050035), N 18,087). Regression-sample cohorts 2015 (78 firms), 2016 (344), 2017 (2), 2018 (124); 3,636 never-treated firms (86.9%); no switch-offs. Per the lead's decision no controls-free spec was written; see the replication log.
